summary: Proposes experimental congestion control algorithms for multipath transport such as Multipath TCP. Using several paths at once is more efficient, but single-path algorithms do not suit it, so the paths' congestion control must be coupled. It is Experimental.

eli5.summary: If you open several roads at once, the drivers must coordinate so they do not all jam the same one. This gives Multipath TCP a way to share load fairly and avoid traffic jams.
